evidence.quote: High rates of job loss and weak income growth are directly reducing what some individuals can spend on housing
further large declines in house prices would accentuate the broader problems in the macroeconomy and financial system through the channels that I just discussed.

We need considerable public support for housing finance until private credit and securitization markets are restarted.
